title: Dynamics of globalization's impact on democratic reality: a study of the Jordanian and Saudi cases
core_idea: Analyze how globalization can both promote and undermine democratic practices and determine which trend predominates by comparing Jordan and Saudi Arabia using statistical, trend, and comparative methods.
tldr: Investigates the dual effects of globalization on democracy and assesses the overall trajectory through quantitative and comparative analysis of Jordan and Saudi Arabia; aims to balance opposing impacts to identify the dominant trend.
